sloka: यत् त्वया धार्मिको रामः नित्यम् सत्य परायणः ।वनम् प्रस्थापितः दुह्खात् पिता च त्रिदिवम् गतः ॥२-७४-१०॥
transliteration: yat tvayā dhārmiko rāmaḥ nityam satya parāyaṇaḥ ।vanam prasthāpitaḥ duhkhāt pitā ca tridivam gataḥ ॥2-74-10॥

translations.english: ﻿ As you sent virtuous Rama, ever devoted to truth, into the forest, my father died out of grief (due to separation from his son). Therefore, you are not the true daughter of the righteous and sagacious king Aswapati but a demoness born there to destroy your father's race.
translations.hindi: महाराज का संदेसा ले कर जो दूत गए थे, उनके जल्दी करने पर ही मैं इतनी जल्दी आया हूँ। हे अम्मा। अब मैं जो कुछ पूछ उसका तू उत्तर मुझे दे
